title: Kalanchoe Pinnata - Cathedral Bells - 2x Mini Plug Plants
description:
Bring a touch of the tropics to your home with these easy-to-grow succulents!


KEY FEATURES
• Vibrant green foliage with red tinges and striking bell-shaped flowers.
• Easy to grow and drought-tolerant, ideal for busy gardeners.
• Unique plantlets form on leaf margins, offering fascinating propagation.
• Adds a tropical touch to indoor spaces and conservatories.
• Low maintenance and resilient, suitable for a range of growing conditions.


PLANT DETAILS
Type: Cacti & Succulents — Kalanchoe pinnata
Colour: Yellow, purple, and red flowers; green foliage (often with red margins)
Season: Late spring/early summer (flowers)
Growth Habit: Upright, succulent perennial shrub


GROWING CONDITIONS
Sun: Bright, direct or indirect light (at least 6 hours daily)
Soil: Well-draining, sandy soil; a cacti/succulent mix is ideal
Watering: Water every 2-4 weeks in spring/summer, every 1-2 months in autumn/winter. Allow top 2 inches of soil to dry completely between waterings.
Spacing: Allow 30-50 cm for mature plants
Height: Up to 1.2 metres (4 feet)
Spread: Up to 60 cm
Hardiness: USDA Zone 10a (can be grown as an annual or overwintered indoors in the UK)


CARE INSTRUCTIONS
• Provide at least six hours of bright light daily, ideally near a south or west-facing window indoors.
• Use a well-draining potting mix, such as a specialist succulent or cacti blend, and a pot with drainage holes.
• Water thoroughly when the top two inches of soil are dry, then allow to drain completely. Avoid overwatering.
• Protect from cold temperatures; bring indoors if temperatures drop below 10°C (50°F).
• Fertilise sparingly, once in late spring/early summer with a diluted balanced fertiliser.


WHAT'S INCLUDED
2x Mini Plug Plants
